kind: synthetic service vectors for a dormant bounded opaque-record relay; opaque bytes only, no PAKE, no AEAD, no end-to-end claim

contract.start: mailbox creation by POST /v1/open; the endpoints open it at the owner's Prepare to send, which the relay cannot observe
contract.timeout: one absolute deadline, creation plus MAX_TTL_SECONDS (relay/src/wire.js), checked on every request and by one alarm; an optional earlier deadline only shortens it; no caller TTL, no slack, no renewal, no reopen
contract.metering: per-source open, put and take rate limits; a per-id poll rate limit; per-mailbox budgets for total requests, empty reads, refused operations and wrong tokens; no poll, read, write or retry resets or extends any budget or the deadline
contract.channel: https only, an exact allowlist of two origins, short polling, JSON bodies only
contract.authentication: the CORS and token checks are not end-to-end user authentication; that is the supervisor ceremony and the key agreement, which this changeset does not implement
contract.failure: a 503 failed answer: for a failure inside the mailbox transaction the operation did not commit; for any other platform failure the outcome is unknown and is not proof that nothing was inserted or consumed; the relay never retries, resends or replays
contract.endpointRows: The early-open mutant and the Prepare to send timing are endpoint rows: the relay cannot observe when the owner starts the ceremony, so the BIOS supervisor and agent-worker owners must test them in their clients. The relay-side stand-ins stay: a clock that starts at the first slot and an open that accepts a payload are mutants that the relay rows must catch.
contract.addressing: How the second party learns the mailbox address is the endpoint ceremony, not the relay. Any short nameplate or lookup the endpoints add must give no oracle beyond the relay's per-id budgets and must not let a guesser squat or consume a live mailbox's setup slots.
contract.reserved: a reserved response slot is writable once and only with a verifier, so it is a one-shot verified take; once every reserved slot has been taken after the final take, the mailbox is deleted
contract.emptyBudget: an empty read over the per-id empty-read budget is the uniform refusal; it never counts as a refusal and never destroys the mailbox; the rate limits and the deadline bound polling

notation.placeholders: a string "$name" in a request is replaced by the value bound to name; in a response it binds name on first use and must equal it afterwards

constants.$CREATED: the relay clock when the scenario starts; its first open happens then
constants.$DEADLINE: $CREATED plus MAX_TTL_SECONDS (relay/src/wire.js) in milliseconds: the one absolute session deadline

notation.expressions: a string "$NAME+N" is the bound number NAME plus N
notation.clock: a step {"clock": {"from": "creation" | "deadline", "offsetMs": n}} sets the relay clock (the synthetic harness) or waits until that time (a live client) before the next step
notation.origin: a step without origin uses defaultOrigin
notation.encoding: data, slot, verifier and token are unpadded base64url; data decodes to one whole envelope of an allowed size

clientDerivations.status: documentation only: obligations of the BIOS supervisor and agent-worker owners, proposed labels for their review; the relay implements none of it and no PAKE is approved
clientDerivations.ikm: the PAKE session key after explicit key confirmation
clientDerivations.setupSlots: unverified PAKE setup slot ids are SHA-256("sliccy-relay/v1 setup " || role || " " || round || " " || mailbox id) truncated to 16 bytes; never derived from the short human code
transcript: SHA-256 of the exact selected bytes
clientDerivations.envelope: nonce, version byte, AEAD ciphertext and tag, padded so that the whole envelope is exactly one allowed size; the excerpt plaintext is at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes inside a 4 KiB envelope

scenarios.name: open takes no payload and no caller TTL; the deadline is creation plus MAX_TTL_SECONDS
absolute expiry: everything works just before the deadline and nothing at it
delayed setup and activity never extend the deadline: no renewal by put, take, poll or retry
an earlier deadline shortens the session; a later one does not lengthen it
no consume, replay or reopen on a late message
session: setup, audience, excerpt, receipt; only the reserved receipt slot is writable after the excerpt take, and only with a verifier
empty polls answer empty with retryAfterMs and burn nothing
a wrong token burns one attempt only; the right token still reads
five wrong tokens destroy the mailbox
only whole-envelope sizes; 4 KiB + 1 and base64 framing mistakes are refused
www and any other origin get an empty 404 with no CORS
an allowed origin is echoed with Vary and no credentials; preflight only for POST and content-type
ids in a query or path answer an empty 404
